text:
Maya Chen: heads-up — pilot cohort (Q1 GTM pilot) renewal calc shows ~42% of accounts with incomplete onboarding steps, mostly tiny pilots (<=5 seats).
Omar Ruiz: do we have a clear pattern? missing kickoff vs product-setup vs owner missing?
Maya Chen: kickoff_call is the dominant missing flag. Also saw a bunch where owner was overwritten after a dedupe run and a lot of contact emails used plus-addressing (jane+trial@...). Dedupe logic ignored those.
Omar Ruiz: ouch. can you paste the detection query?
Maya Chen: sure — quick ad-hoc:
```sql
select account_id, count(distinct contact_email) as contacts, max(owner) as owner,
       bool_or((onboarding->>'kickoff_call') = 'true') as kickoff_done
from crm.accounts
where cohort = 'q1-pilot'
group by account_id
having bool_or((onboarding->>'kickoff_call') = 'false')
```
Maya Chen: returned ~120 accounts. sample shows owner null for ~18 of them after last dedupe job.
CS Bot: :rotating_light: automations delivery failure — POST /playbooks/trigger returned 502 for 12 accounts (2026-03-20T02:14Z). Logged as delivery-id 8f2c.
Elena Gupta: we should canonicalize emails before dedupe. simple normalizer:
```python
def normalize_email(e):
    local, domain = e.split('@')
    local = local.split('+')[0].lower()
    return f"{local}@{domain.lower()}"
```
Elena Gupta: also strip dots for gmail domains if we want stricter matching.
Pat Reynolds: can someone run a normalization + dedupe dry-run against staging? I can kick it off but want guardrails for owner reassignment.
Omar Ruiz: run with --dry-run and output proposed owner changes to a csv. We should also pass an owner-preserve rule for accounts with active playbook tasks.
Maya Chen: proposal: add an "onboarding-sentinel" playbook that tags accounts missing kickoff_call 14 days after account_created, then notifys owner at +7 and +3 days before renewal calc. Also a one-off cleanup: 1) email normalization dry-run 2) dedupe dry-run (owner-preserve) 3) run dedupe in prod window 4) enable sentinel.
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: I can schedule staging run this Fri 09:00 PT and capture outputs. Who owns the playbook ticket?
Maya Chen: I'll open the ticket and assign to Pat (CS-4551). Will include required SQL, normalizer snippet, and desired owner-preserve heuristics.
CS Bot: created ticket CS-4551: "pilot onboarding sentinel + dedupe cleanup". Will post updates to #customer-success when runs complete.
Pat Reynolds: ack — will review dry-run results and propose rollback steps. If staging looks good, plan prod run Mon 02:00 UTC.
Maya Chen: thanks. deliverable checklist in ticket: run logs, owner-change csv, affected account list, dashboard metric (pilot_onboard_incomplete_pct) to track.
Jordan Lee: noted. tagging @here for visibility. :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: ok closing thread for now — will update CS-4551 with next steps and drop a short runbook for on-call if owner collisions occur.
